tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe reveals the predicted avalanche regime. Fit the verified threshold law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations fall sharply below the smooth pilot trend, indicating a supercritical loss.
The probe varies gradient and substrate separately from the pilot trend, and the verified threshold mechanism explains the high-gradient collapse.
Eight observations now constrain the five-parameter threshold model; additional trajectory measurements are not needed before confirmation.
